item.text: {"evidence_refs":["dev_0","dev_6","observed_A_0","observed_A_8","fresh_1_0","fresh_1_4","fresh_1_8","fresh_1_12"],"experiments":[{"h":0.5,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Compare lag-position effects across current-drive values at the same waiting time; this probes whether a fitted history response transfers beyond the supplied u values.","u":-0.6},{"h":2.0,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Repeat the lag-position comparison at a longer waiting time to test history-by-waiting-time interaction.","u":0.7},{"h":0.5,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Contrast an old versus recent pulse against the first condition at matched u and h, testing the time-position dependence directly.","u":0.7},{"h":2.0,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Pair with the third condition at a longer wait to assess whether the old-versus-recent pulse contrast changes with h.","u":-0.6}],"exposed_inputs":["u","h","history","times","dt"],"expression":"a+b*u+c*h+sum(history*(k0*exp(times[0]/tau)+k1*exp(times[1]/tau)+k2*exp(times[2]/tau)+k3*exp(times[3]/tau)))","measurement_requests":[],"parameters":[{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.0,"lower":-3.0,"name":"a","upper":3.0},{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.8,"lower":-3.0,"name":"b","upper":3.0},{"dimension":[-1,1],"initial":-0.1,"lower":-2.0,"name":"c","upper":2.0},{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.25,"lower":-2.0,"name":"k0","upper":2.0},{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.3,"lower":-2.0,"name":"k1","upper":2.0},{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.35,"lower":-2.0,"name":"k2","upper":2.0},{"dimension":[0,1],"initial":0.45,"lower":-2.0,"name":"k3","upper":2.0},{"dimension":[1,0],"initial":2.0,"lower":0.1,"name":"tau","upper":10.0}],"quantities":[{"expression":"sum(history*(k0*exp(times[0]/tau)+k1*exp(times[1]/tau)+k2*exp(times[2]/tau)+k3*exp(times[3]/tau)))","interpretation":"Dimensionless-scale contribution to response from prior drive history, with separate fitted weights for each lag interval and exponential waiting-time decay.","name":"history_effect"}],"rationale":"The old state-only response misses history-dependent contrasts, and the supplied C5/C6 models with a single discounted summary retain substantial dev error. This replacement allows each of the four history positions to have its own fitted weight while preserving explicit current-drive and waiting-time effects. Because coefficients are refit on fit rows and the history values there vary broadly, the model tests whether lag position matters without presuming a specific unique mechanism. The dev and matched-history observations show strong response changes with history and waiting time; the fresh observations add matched-u, matched-h lag contrasts. No dev RMSE is supplied for this proposed model, so passing the 0.06 criterion is not established until evaluation.","scientific_change":"Replace a single exponential history summary with a flexible four-lag weighted history response whose weights share an exponential time-decay scale, allowing distinct contributions from prior intervals while retaining additive current drive and waiting-time terms."}
